name: Dock weather tarp

interactions.name: Connected dock entry, shared deck and hut
interactions.note: Entry and deck meet at their authored connection. The submarine and hut retain their deck-relative registration, with the hut to the submarine’s right.

requirements.notes: Hut stays to submarine right. Peek holes in cover. Docked ship reuses submarine-yellow with dock charging/ready presentations; no duplicate ship design or charge timer.

productionStage: Native Blender · approved Faceted lighting and materials

compositionContext.explanation: Patchwork weather tarp covering the docked submarine and workshop; folds to the back when the dock is uncovered.

socketSpace: root-relative logical pixels projected from declared native attachment points

validation.rigEvidence: exported; native and complete capture audits passed

reviewNote: A 3 × 3 overhead cloth shelter for the docked submarine and workshop. The patchwork roof has rolled hems, a ridge and ties; the uncover animation folds it toward the back. It is an overhead layer, separate from the dock floor.

artStyle.lighting: Faceted 140 W overhead plus four equal 100 W cardinal fills
artStyle.woodRefinement: crate only: linear albedo × 0.42, roughness 1, specular 0
